name: DWD Weather (Deutscher Wetterdienst)
description: DWD weather for Mittelfranken using DWD's public open-data services (ADR-0026). weather.warnings is LIVE (E18-02): the CAP 1.2 DISTRICT feed, filtered to the configured places' warncells (bundled data/mittelfranken.json). weather.radar (E18-03, GeoServer WMS) and weather.observations (E18-04, POI CSV) still raise. Target places Nürnberg / Fürth / Erlangen / Schwabach / Ansbach / Neustadt a.d. Aisch. Outbound HTTPS to opendata.dwd.de / maps.dwd.de only, no credentials, no new runtime dependency (stdlib urllib/zipfile/ElementTree).
